headline: down to $0.080 in a market-wide sell-off, testing December 2025 lows
lede: Canton Coin (CC) price, chart levels and three scenarios for the week ahead, plus what's happening with CNTN stock. Plain English, no hype.
summary: Canton Coin is at $0.0801 (about R1.36), down about 14% this week and 24% this month, its lowest price since December 2025. The whole crypto market fell hard: Bitcoin about 14% and Ether about 19% over 7 days, and the Fear and Greed Index sits at 10, Extreme Fear. The $0.091 support from last week gave way on 9 November. On the network side the news kept coming: Nomura was approved as a Super Validator on 10 November and Digital Asset signed a tokenized Japanese government bond deal with Progmat. CNTN stock fell about 17% to $1.71, close to its 52 week low.
summary_plain: Canton Coin at $0.0801, down about 14% this week in a market-wide sell-off. Support $0.075, resistance $0.0855. Nomura approved as a Super Validator. Scenarios and CNTN stock for 15 November 2026.

changed: 📉 Price fell from $0.0927 to $0.0801, about 14%. It touched about $0.075 on Kraken on 15 November, the lowest since December 2025.
🌍 It was not only Canton: Bitcoin fell about 14% and Ether about 19% in the same 7 days, and the Fear and Greed Index dropped from 28 to 10.
🧱 Last week's $0.091 support broke on 9 November and the next try at $0.088 gave way on 13 November. Old support is now resistance.
🏯 Nomura (with BOOSTRY) was approved as a Super Validator on 10 November (CIP-0130), and CapConnect+, a commercial paper platform built with Walmart, applied to become one (CIP-0131).
📉 CNTN stock fell from $2.06 to $1.71 (about -17%), and touched $1.66, its 52 week low, on 13 November.
technicals: Down: lower highs since February, and a new lower low this week
About 28: oversold territory for the first time in these reports
Below its signal line and below zero, the gap widening again (bearish)
Rising on the drop: about $17 to $20 million a day, double last week's quiet days
About $34 million open interest across 36 perpetual markets (Binance about $10.6 million). Funding is close to flat, no crowded bets either way
levels: 9 to 12 November closes, last week's support now overhead
14 November level, where the slide sped up
15 November intraday low and the December 2025 trading range
Mid December 2025 base, where buyers held for a week
scenarios: Oversold bounce toward $0.091, then the 20 day average near $0.094
Sideways while the whole market looks for a floor
Opens $0.071, and below that the December lows
fundamentals: 🏦 Institutions keep arriving: Nomura approved as a Super Validator with a milestone-based weight of up to 10 (CIP-0130, 10 November). Digital Asset and Progmat signed an MOU on 10 November to bring tokenized Japanese government bonds and repo onto Canton Network. CapConnect+ proposed itself as a Super Validator (CIP-0131), and Canton Network says DTCC's service puts over $30 trillion of assets within reach on-chain.

🔥 Burn vs mint: no new full measurement this week. The latest independent figure (CantonNews, 8 November) was about 15.2 million CC burned against 21.9 million minted per day, so supply still grows. Universal burn (CIP-0129, approved) is expected from Q1 2027.

⚠️ Ecosystem housekeeping: the Edel token project reported about $300,000 of EDEL tokens stolen, and Console Wallet paused and then restored its services (12 November). Neither notice says the Canton network itself was compromised. Canton 3.7.3 shipped a sequencer fix, and the Splice 0.10.0 MainNet upgrade is scheduled for 16 November.

🧰 Grants: the development fund approved 4.59 million CC for a privacy (TEE) covalidator by Financial Privacy Inc. and 1.27 million CC for Python tooling by Obsidian Systems, and OpenZeppelin's Canton library passed review. No unlocks, ETF filings or new spot listings found.
cntn_notes: CNTN is Canton Strategic Holdings, a Nasdaq company that holds about 3.7 billion CC. It is not Digital Asset, the private company that built Canton Network.
Tokenized CNTN shares made their first trades on TSV LLC on 4 November. No wider access was announced this week: only verified participants can trade, and South African access has not been announced.
On 12 November the company publicly backed Digital Asset's stand against front-running (MEV), saying Canton Network's design keeps orders private. No new filings that change the picture were found.
You can buy CNTN through Interactive Brokers from most countries, or any US broker. See the step-by-step guide.
bottom_line: 📉 CC broke last week's support and is at its lowest since December 2025, in step with a market-wide sell-off. $0.075 is the level to watch.
🏦 The institutional story got stronger (Nomura, Progmat, CapConnect+), but supply still grows and CC itself is not yet the thing banks buy.
👀 RSI near 28 says sellers are stretched. Watch for a daily close back above $0.0855 before reading anything into a bounce.
